Class S3OutputFile

java.lang.Object
dev.hardwood.s3.S3OutputFile
All Implemented Interfaces:
OutputFile, Closeable, AutoCloseable
public final class S3OutputFile extends Object implements OutputFile

An OutputFile that writes one S3 object, created by S3Source.outputFile(String, String).

The object is sent as a multipart upload, or in a single PUT when it is smaller than one part, and appears at its key only once close() succeeds. discard() aborts the upload. See S3Source.outputFile(String, String) for buffering, size limits and failure handling.

    • discard

      public void discard() throws IOException

      Waits for the part uploads in flight to end and aborts the multipart upload, if one was started. Does nothing once the output is closed.

      The wait and the abort run with the thread's interrupt status cleared, and the status restored afterwards, so that an interrupted writer still releases its parts.

      Specified by:
      discard in interface OutputFile
      Throws:
      IOException - if resources cannot be released
